summary_en: Public tender offer by Muninova Holdings completed 2026-07-02. 7,100,712 shares tendered (minimum threshold 5,186,700 met). Concurrent acquisition of 6,408,000 Anshin Guarantor shares held by Aiful via dividend in kind on settlement date 2026-07-09. Post-settlement, Muninova to hold >50% voting rights and become parent company; Aiful to cease being material shareholder.
title_en: Notice regarding the Results of Public Tender Offer on Anshin Guarantor Shares by Muninova Holdings and the Changes in Parent Company, Other Related Companies, Principal Shareholders and Top Shareholder
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-02, Muninova Holdings Co., Ltd. completed a public tender offer on Anshin Guarantor Service Co., Ltd. ordinary shares and subscription rights, which had commenced on 2026-05-13. The offer succeeded: 7,100,712 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 5,186,700 shares. Settlement is scheduled for 2026-07-09. Concurrently, Muninova will acquire the entire stake (6,408,000 shares) held by Aiful Co., Ltd. through a dividend-in-kind distribution on the settlement date. Upon completion of both transactions, Muninova's voting right ratio will exceed 50%, causing Muninova to become Anshin Guarantor's parent company and top shareholder, while Aiful ceases to be a material shareholder. Aiful is itself a wholly-owned subsidiary of Muninova. The filing does not disclose the tender price, aggregate yen value, or the ex-treasury shares outstanding denominator needed to compute pct_so.
